units.translation: a burden not easy to embrace
and came lamentable woes, not in word
Why do you not hate the god most hateful to the gods?
Who does not grieve with your woes?
What profit is it for me to live, but did I not quickly hurl myself from this rugged rock?
Do you not think there is need of saving thought?
Why do you not approach for help?
Do you not fear this more?
Or do you not know that—?
Did I not perceive them falling out of these things?
Are you not a child and even more foolish than this one?
Will you not be silent and say none of these things throughout the city?
I will not be caught by trickery
for you will not escape fate any more
and you will never betray the dead
I will never leave that man
they will not keep their hands from us
the flashing eye of a young woman will not escape my notice
for you will never say that—
for it is not easy to cross
for this is not to be spoken
for surely you have not uttered this intolerable word
for you will not escape fate any more
for the sacrifices are not good
for he wishes not to seem best, but to be
for he did not know the future from the gods
for we will not betray our dearest
for a child still in swaddling clothes does not speak
for not suitable for the house
for you have not been conquered
for they did not raise me
for I am not a guest
for I will suffer nothing greater than this
for he did not let go after biting
for whom it is not fated to die
for I would not address you
for it happens not some things, others not
for he will not rule the gods for long
no, not before casting this land into danger
no, if indeed it will be
no, if a god directs Orestes to come here
there is no escape, no, strangers, in longer time
who, when you had planned death for him, did not dare to do this deed with your own hand
and the multitude of evils, not even if I should recount for ten days, could I fill up for you
never did I say on the prophetic thrones, not about man, not about woman, not about city
and the army of the Greeks did not at all make a secret sailing out
we do not wish, mother, either to frighten you too much with words or to encourage you
they did not deem worthy even to look at all
Zeus is not softened by such men
How does the expense not become bitter?
and not, and not, and not, and not
for it was not terrible that he might be caught
